steps: This is Claude at work: how Maya, an analyst at Brightline, becomes her team's A I fluent lead. It starts with help me with reports, which gets generic advice, and the four Ds of A I fluency.
Next, her onboarding procedure stops vanishing into chat scrollback. Claude returns it as an Artifact, with one stable link for the whole team.
Then the same prompt gives three different answers, so Maya sends a four part prompt with role, context, task and format, and gets consistent output.
Maya parks her three hundred word brief and glossary in a team Project. Every chat inherits the rules, and her prompts shrink to fifty words.
After two approximate totals, Code Execution has Claude run Python in a sandbox, which returns exactly forty-four thousand two hundred and eighty-seven dollars, and Maya verifies it.
Maya spots salaries in performance reviews, so she classifies, redacts and reviews the data before anything goes to Claude.
Then a three hundred percent growth statistic turns out to be invented. Maya pinpoints it, finds no primary source, and re-prompts before it reaches the board.

Put together, these habits make Maya her team's A I fluent lead. Clear prompts, the right tools and careful checks turn Claude into a teammate you can trust. The full walkthrough is in the Gennoor Claude certification course.
